# Himali

> > Himali creates technical outdoor apparel and mountaineering gear inspired by Sherpa culture and Himalayan expeditions, featuring sustainable materials like Polartec, bluesign® certified fabrics, and Fair Trade certification.

Based in Boulder, Colorado, Himali produces performance apparel for alpine climbing and high-altitude mountaineering, backed by their 8000 Meter Guarantee. The brand partners with Sherpa athletes like Tendi Sherpa and Pa Dawa Sherpa, sharing mountaineering stories from Nepal and the Himalayas.

## Key Topics

- Himali brand and technical apparel
- Mountaineering and alpine climbing
- Sherpa culture and athletes (Tendi Sherpa, Pa Dawa Sherpa)
- Sustainable materials (bluesign®, Fair Trade Certified, Polartec, Primaloft)
- 8000 Meter Guarantee
- Nepal and Himalayan expeditions
- Moisture-wicking and sun protection (UPF 50+)
- Technical layering systems
- Boulder, Colorado outdoor community
- Fleece and hardshell outerwear
- Base layers and tech tees
- Everest and 8000m peaks
- Khembalung collection

## Technical Apparel Collections

- [Fleece](https://www.himali.com/collections/fleece): Collection of fleece hoodies and pullovers for men and women
- [BLUESIGN® COLLECTION](https://www.himali.com/collections/bluesign-collection): Eco-certified sustainable outerwear with Bluesign® textile tracing
- [Big Objectives](https://www.himali.com/collections/big-objectives): Technical performance apparel collection for challenging outdoor pursuits
- [PRESALE](https://www.himali.com/collections/presale): Pre-order collection for upcoming outdoor apparel and gear releases

## Featured Products

- [MENS MONSOON HARDSHELL PANT by HIMALI](https://www.himali.com/products/mens-monsoon-hardshell-pant-2-0): Waterproof 3-layer hardshell pant with Toray membrane and YKK zippers
- [MENS BOULDER ELEVATION TECH TEE](https://www.himali.com/products/boulder-elevation-tech-tee): Moisture-wicking men's tech tee with UPF 50+ and Fair Trade certification
- [ICE PICK BOULDER HAT - TRAILBLAZER BLUE](https://www.himali.com/products/ice-pick-boulder-hat): Lightweight 5-panel performance hat in Trailblazer Blue with flat brim
- [THE HIMALI SKULL CAP](https://www.himali.com/products/himali-skull-cap): Fleece-insulated skull cap designed as helmet liner for cold expeditions

- [Pa Dawa Sherpa](https://www.himali.com/pages/pa-dawa-sherpa): Athlete profile of Pa Dawa Sherpa, high-altitude mountaineer
